user.current_work: Home lesson teacher (maths + chemistry for JSS/SSS)
user.health_constraints: Mother has diabetes, need to be reachable within 2 hours of Ibadan

user_snapshot: Microbiology grad, 1 year post-NYSC, stuck teaching JSS/SSS lessons for ₦40k in Ibadan while your mother's diabetes keeps you tethered within 2 hours of the city. ₦200k saved, ₦25k monthly obligation, high family pressure to 'get a real job'.
headline_insight: Your 2-hour Ibadan radius is not a limitation — it's actually an advantage. The Sagamu–Ota–Agbara pharma corridor is 90-120 minutes from Ibadan by road, and Microbiology graduates are exactly who those QA departments hire. Most of your peers looking at Lagos tech are ignoring the industry built for your degree on your doorstep.

routes.title: Pharma QA Analyst → Senior QA / International Lab Tech
routes.one_liner: Enter the Sagamu-Agbara pharma corridor as a QA analyst, build 2-3 years experience, then either promote internally or pivot to Canada/UK lab tech route.

fit_reasons.note: Microbiology Second Class Upper from a federal university is the exact profile Emzor, Fidson, and May & Baker QA departments hire.
Sagamu and Ota pharma plants are 90-120 min from Ibadan, within your 2-hour radius for your mother.

break_reasons.risk: QA shift rotations (including nights) may conflict with emergency availability for your mother's diabetes episodes.

routes.who_this_fits: Science graduates who want a credentialed career path, don't mind SOPs and structure, and value stability over upside.
routes.who_this_breaks: People who need remote flexibility or get bored by repetitive lab protocols and documentation.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Relocation to Sagamu/Ota or 3-hour daily commute. First 2 months may overlap with lesson income before you fully switch.

real_pay.range_note: Entry ₦120-180k depending on company. Emzor and Fidson pay above Nigerian average pharma; smaller firms ₦100k floor.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you stick with pharma QA, you're earning ₦250-320k/mo as a QA Analyst II at Emzor or Fidson, have ₦1.5m saved, and have booked IELTS for the Canada MLT pathway.
pro_tips: Apply directly via company careers pages — recruiters filter MyJobMag heavily.
Mention specific SOPs like USP/BP testing in your CV summary.

monday_actions.step: Rewrite CV with pharma QA keywords (GMP, SOP, microbial limit test, sterility) and send to careers@emzorpharma.com, hr@fidson.com, recruitment@may-baker.com.
DM 5 QA Analysts at Emzor/Fidson/GSK Nigeria on LinkedIn asking about the application route for Microbiology grads.
Join the Nigerian Pharma Professionals WhatsApp group via Pharmanews.ng contact page and post in the jobs thread.

milestones: Own one SOP area (micro lab or QC)
QA Analyst II promotion OR book IELTS for Canada MLT

routes.nigerian_notes: Corridor firms expect you to relocate or commute. Many offer subsidised hostel accommodation near plants. Lagos traffic makes daily Ibadan commute brutal — plan to rent in Sagamu/Ota (₦150-300k/yr for single room) and travel back to Ibadan weekends.

routes.title: International School Teacher (Sciences) → Head of Science Dept
routes.one_liner: Convert your existing teaching into a formal role at an Ibadan private/international school paying 4-8x your current lesson income, within your 2-hour radius.

fit_reasons.note: Your existing teaching skill (maths + chemistry JSS/SSS) plus Microbiology degree is exactly what Ibadan private schools hire for science.
School-hour schedule (8am-3pm) keeps you local in Ibadan and reachable for your mother's diabetes emergencies.

break_reasons.risk: Ceiling at ₦300-500k/mo in Ibadan market; to hit Lagos international school pay (₦500-800k) you'd have to leave your 2-hour radius.

routes.who_this_fits: Graduates who genuinely enjoy teaching, want stability + school holidays, and have family-care constraints.
routes.who_this_breaks: People who see teaching as a fallback — students smell resentment and the pay ceiling frustrates within 3 years.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Evening lesson freelance income during application period. TRCN registration fee ₦15-25k and possible 1-year PGDE if school demands it.

real_pay.range_note: Ibadan ceiling lower than Lagos. Top Ibadan schools: Lead British, Vivian Fowler, The International School Ibadan (UI), Lifeforte — these pay the upper band.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, you're a Senior Science Teacher at Lead British or The International School Ibadan earning ₦250-300k/mo, with TRCN cert and a clear path to Head of Science or UK international school placement (Dubai/Qatar).
pro_tips: Apply in April-June — schools recruit before September resumption.
Mention WAEC/IGCSE chemistry experience even from lesson work.

routes.nigerian_notes: Ibadan has a strong private school market anchored by UI community — The International School Ibadan, Lifeforte, Lead British, Abadina. Pay is 60-70% of Lagos equivalents but cost of living is 50% lower. TRCN registration is becoming mandatory; get it early.

routes.title: Data Analyst (Excel → SQL → Python) → Remote USD Role
routes.one_liner: Leverage your existing Excel + research skills into a data analyst role — first local (banking/fintech/health), then remote USD within 18-24 months.

fit_reasons.note: Your existing Excel + research skills are the entry base for data analytics — you're not starting from zero.
Remote work means you stay in Ibadan, near your mother with diabetes, with no commute.

break_reasons.risk: Your ₦200k savings + ₦25k monthly obligation can't support a 6-month study phase with zero income — you must keep lessons running in parallel.

routes.who_this_fits: Disciplined self-learners who can do 2-3 hours nightly for 9-12 months while working a day job.
routes.who_this_breaks: People who need external structure, or who quit when first 30 applications get ignored (they will).

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Evenings and weekends for 9-12 months. No social life. Slow first income ramp — lessons stay as your floor until month 9.

real_pay.range_note: Local junior ₦150-300k. Remote junior $500-1500/mo (₦750k-2.2m). Senior remote $3-5k/mo. USD-pegged — inflation-proof.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you grind the nightly study, you're earning ₦600-900k/mo as a mid-level data analyst at a Nigerian fintech (Moniepoint, Kuda) or a remote role via Turing, working from Ibadan.
pro_tips: Do Google Data Analytics cert on Coursera (₦0 with financial aid).
Build 3 portfolio projects using Nigerian datasets — NBS, CBN.

routes.nigerian_notes: The junior data market is saturated — thousands of bootcamp grads competing. Your edge is domain knowledge (science/research background) pitched to health-tech or pharma-adjacent analytics. Do not pay ₦500k+ for bootcamps — free routes (Google cert, DataCamp scholarships, Kaggle) work if you're disciplined.

routes.title: Canada Medical Lab Technologist (MLT) Route
routes.one_liner: Use your Microbiology degree + 2 years Nigerian pharma QA experience to credential as a Medical Lab Technologist in Canada (CAD 70-95k/year).

fit_reasons.note: Microbiology Second Class Upper from a federal university is accepted for CSMLS credential evaluation, the Canadian MLT gatekeeper.
Your 'curious' JAPA appetite + medium risk tolerance + 24-month horizon matches the MLT pathway timeline perfectly.

break_reasons.risk: Leaving your mother (diabetes, needs you within 2 hours) is the real blocker — you need a family plan before flight date.

routes.who_this_fits: Science grads with family support for mother's care, ₦8m+ accessible (through savings + loan + family), and patience for 18-month credential process.
routes.who_this_breaks: Sole caregivers and people who can't fund the CSMLS exam + relocation without going into toxic debt.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: ₦200k savings won't cover this alone — needs family support or 2 years of pharma QA savings first. Leaving mother's daily care radius.

real_pay.range_note: Canadian MLT entry CAD 60-75k/yr = ₦4-5m/mo NGN equivalent. After tax + rent, net savings CAD 15-25k/yr realistic.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if the pharma QA → Canada route works, you're in Ontario or Alberta completing the CSMLS prior-learning assessment, earning CAD 4-5k/mo (₦4m+) as a lab assistant while finalising MLT certification.
pro_tips: Start with CSMLS PLA application — cheaper than full Canadian school.
Alberta and Saskatchewan have faster MLT licensing than Ontario.

routes.nigerian_notes: Do this route AFTER 18-24 months of pharma QA — that experience funds the move, strengthens your CSMLS PLA, and lets you arrange your mother's care. Do NOT do this as first route from ₦200k savings. Stack pharma QA income first, then JAPA. Many 'agents' scam Nigerians on this route — deal only with CSMLS directly.

routes_filtered_out.route: Big 4 Audit Graduate Programme (KPMG, PwC, EY, Deloitte)
routes_filtered_out.reason: You're 1 year post-NYSC with a Microbiology degree — the graduate programme window targets fresh Accounting/Economics grads in campus recruitment cycles. Not a realistic route.

routes_filtered_out.route: Tech bootcamp (AltSchool, Decagon) for software engineering
routes_filtered_out.reason: ₦500k-1m bootcamp fees exceed your entire savings, and saturated junior dev market means 6+ months to first income — your ₦25k monthly obligation can't survive that gap.
5-7 year zero-income commitment is impossible with your mother's diabetes care and family obligation; also typically requires entry at 15-22 with family connection into a master.
Regional field roles require constant travel across South-West — pulls you outside the 2-hour Ibadan radius your mother's condition demands.
₦18-30m total cost is 90x your current savings. Even with a 2-year pharma QA stack, the numbers don't close without family co-funding.
